ns2:section.sectionText: This course is meant for econ students with an interest in graduate school and covers the application materials, preparation, program selection, experiences, and many other areas important for before, during, and after graduate school. Class will consist of collaborative activities, guest speakers, and discussions. Primarily for non-professional programs (not necessarily for MBA, MSA, MFA). RESTRICTED TO DECLARED ECONOMICS STUDENTS ALWAYS (priority given to Juniors/Seniors). **Interested Econ students should submit a completed form via the link in order to be given permission to register for the course. Sign-up link: http://go.illinois.edu/econ198gradschool
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Economics department.
